content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — page fired: HIGH — serving-runtime error-rate spike in prod. Alert: serving.error_rate > 5% across us-west cluster. Count: 342 alerts in last 5m. Pages: 3. Auto-grouping: merged 342 alerts into incident PDX-8173. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PDX-8173

pagerduty-bot: Page to Alex Chen (primary) at 2026-03-14T01:24:16Z

Alex Chen: acked :hand: I'm on it. Starting runbook serve-error-rate.

Marta Ruiz: I see same spike on dashboards. Noted increased 5xxs for model-infer (g4dn). Beginning log tail.

Alex Chen: running quick checks: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=serving --sort-by=.status.startTime`

Ryan Patel: heads-up — we've had flappy autoscaler events earlier, could be rollout-related. I'll check deployment history.

incident-bot: Auto-group/suppression: 342 alerts -> 1 incident. Suppressed 339 duplicate pages. Remaining pages: 3 (primary, escalation to #2, critical).

Tasha Li: I'm on customer-impact. Any specific customers seeing errors? We should post to #support-impact after initial triage.

Alex Chen: quick findings: error pattern is `grpc: received RST_STREAM` from model-shard-2. KV cache hits drop correlates.

Marta Ruiz: commands I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n prod logs svc/model-shard-2 --tail=200 | grep 'RST_STREAM' | head
```

Ryan Patel: scaling note — there's a pending node drain earlier today in us-west1. Kube autoscaler might have overcompensated. Checking node events.

pagerduty-bot: Page to Ryan Patel (escalation) after 2m timeout.

Ryan Patel: acked. I can patch a temporary pod anti-affinity to avoid co-locating shards. Creating patch now.

Alex Chen: trying a targeted restart of model-shard-2: `kubectl rollout restart deployment model-shard-2 -n prod --field-manager=manual`

incident-bot: Note: we're limiting noisy alerts. Issuing silence: `incident-bot silence --incident=PDX-8173 --scope=serving.error_rate --duration=30m --reason='paging storm dedupe while we triage'`

Marta Ruiz: thanks — that suppression blocked ~150 incoming pages in the last 2m. :white_check_mark:

Tasha Li: created initial customer-impact note: "Partial 5xx increase affecting embed-generation for select partners; majority requests succeed; estimated affected sessions ~12%" Posting to #support-impact.

Alex Chen: model-shard-2 restarted. Observing error-rate down from 5.8% -> 1.9% in 90s.

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: incident PDX-8173 status -> acknowledged. Pages suppressed: 330. Next escalation window cleared.

Ryan Patel: pushed affinity patch. No other nodes showing RST_STREAM. Looks like a NIC flake on node-07. Marking node-07 for drain.

Alex Chen: thanks. I'll monitor for 20m. If stable, we'll resolve and post RCA later.

Marta Ruiz: preparing short postmortem stub and owner assignment. Will hand to on-call for the 08:00 UTC shift if it stays stable.

Tasha Li: adding customer follow-up template and tagging CSMs.

Alex Chen: handing off to Ryan for watch. Ryan, take over for next hour?

Ryan Patel: taking handoff. I'll update thread if anything flares. Setting personal reminder for 20min.

incident-bot: Incident PDX-8173 auto-closed alert grouping after 45m of stability? Wait – keep messages: last alert cleared. If no new alerts, we will resolve in 30m.

Alex Chen: resolving the page in PD: `pagerduty resolve PDX-8173 --note 'Restarted model-shard-2; drained node-07; suppressed duplicate pages; monitoring'`

pagerduty-bot: Resolved incident PDX-8173. Closing notifications.

Tasha Li: creating customer comms draft now. Will circulate.

Marta Ruiz: +1. Postmortem owner: Alex Chen. ETA draft EOD.
